name: "Hectic Highway" RC Endless Dodger
author: MarioZvZ
description: Welcome! Thanks for taking a try at this game I have created, a little RC Plane on a endless "Hectic Highway" 0.o Just dodging and seeing how long you can last. This project is a little showcase of what the Unity Beginner Course has taught me, with my own twist to see what I could do with what I learned and what assets I was given, the assets are from Project 1/5 and I would love to add more to this game i.e a leaderboard, increased spawn rate over time, sound and effects, ect. Next I will be doing a game post from every project in the Unity Beginner Course so please enjoy, send feedback, and expect more things to come!
